mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Responsibilities:
Work with international teams of developers, fostering a collaborative and productive environment.
Participate in Agile project workflows, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Maintain and update the Azure DevOps Dashboard to reflect project progress and timelines.
Work on technical objectives and actionable tasks.
Technical Development:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Node.js and JavaScript.
Implement and manage databases such as PostgreSQL, MSSQL, or MariaDB.
Ensure code quality through code reviews, testing, and adherence to best practices.
Communication:
English speaking skill is required.
The ability to read and understand technical specifications and participate in email communication with international teams is required.
yeu_cau:
Minimum 3-5 years of experience as a Full-Stack Developer.
Backend: Proficiency in NodeJS / NestJS.
Frontend: Strong skills with ReactJS / NextJS.
JavaScript Ecosystem Expertise:
Build tools: Vite, Webpack
Testing: Jest, Cypress, React Testing Library
Data fetching: React Query
Code quality: ESLint, Prettier
Proficient with Docker and relational databases (MariaDB / MySQL/Postgres).
Prior experience working with Linux-based VMs in a production environment
Familiarity with agile methodologies and hands-on experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bamboo, or Jenkins.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript and CSS.
Solid understanding of Git and version control best practices.
WHO ARE SUITABLE FOR THIS JOB AND WHO ARE NOT APPLICABLE
Moderate experienced engineers with 3-5 years of experience in NodeJS/NestJS and ReactJS/NextJS.
Not suitable for fresh graduates or junior engineers without professional experience.

Engineer platforms that operate at global scale
